text:
maria.g: Heads up — noticed a big spike on the billing heatmap this morning. tenant_tag cardinality shot up and a bunch of late events are landing after invoice-preview cut. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/heatmap/xyz :eyes:

kiran: yeah saw it around 08:42 UTC. looks like session_id-derived tags exploded from a customer-side change. spikes are causing preview != final invoice for some tenants.

samir: quick query I ran to spot the late events:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as late_cnt, max(event_ts) - min(event_ts) as span
FROM billing_events
WHERE event_ingest_ts > invoice_cut_ts
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY late_cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

alex: are we sure it's just cardinality + late arrivals? could be duplicate retries from the proxy too. any visibility on fingerprint or retries?

kiran: pattern looks like both. a change in client SDK started attaching `session_id` that wasn't scrubbed, so cardinality exploded. and our ingest retry policy (3x) + no stable fingerprint produced duplicates that land after cut.

samir: two quick mitigation ideas:
1) pipeline: enforce `late_arrival_window=2h` watermark for invoice-preview path (drop or tag events after window)
2) aggregator: pre-aggregate by `tenant_id` and `route_alias` instead of free-form tags, plus bucket rare tag values into `__other__` to control heatmap cardinality
config snippet we could try in ingest: 
```yaml
invoice_preview_pipe:
  watermark: 2h
  dedupe_key: event_fingerprint || request_id
  tag_cardinality_keep: 500
```

billing-bot: Created BILL-5923: "late events + high-cardinality tags causing invoice preview drift" and linked to runbook.

devops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to `staging-metering` at 09:30 UTC (2 nodes). Rolling window metrics: `preview_diff_pct`, `unique_tag_count`, `late_event_rate`.

sophie: From UX/product: if we add a `reconciliation window` control to the invoice preview page, we should surface a tooltip: "Events arriving after this window will be excluded from preview and may appear on final invoice." Also suggest a small heatmap legend showing bucket threshold (e.g., top 500 tags then "other").

maria.g: Action items: kiran -> implement watermark + dedupe key in pipeline canary (kicked off now); samir -> add pre-agg + cardinality bucket in preview path; sophie -> mockup reconciliation window control + tooltip by EOD; alex -> run a quick dedupe/fingerprint audit on proxy. I'll triage BILL-5923 and ping finance if previews diverge more than 3% in next 24h.

kiran: noted, starting PR now. will post canary logs and `preview_diff_pct` alerts in this thread.

samir: will add a lightweight dashboard card (single stat) to surface `unique_tag_count` and `late_event_rate` on the metering overview so the oncall can see when this regresses.

maria.g: thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups. will do a summary in #incidents if we need broader comms.
